metadata.title: Notify Parent Complete
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Notify parent process that sub-process has completed by updating parent's memory. Used at end of sub-processes.

summary.description: Brief summary of what was accomplished

output.description: Parent memory updated with completion status

prerequisites: This must be a sub-process with a parent reference
specificActions: Check if Sub-Process: Read own memory.json 'Sub-Process State' section; check 'Parent Process' field; if 'None' or not a sub-process, skip this step
Read Parent Memory: Locate parent process directory from parent reference; read parent's memory.json
Update Parent's Child Sub-Processes Table: Find this sub-process entry; update status from 'running' to 'completed' (or 'failed'); add completion summary if provided
Write Parent Memory: Save updated parent memory.json; parent will see completion when it continues
bestPractices: Always check if this is a sub-process first
Include meaningful summary for parent to use
This is a 'push' notification - parent doesn't need to poll

substeps.name: Check if this is a sub-process
substeps.description: Check if process has a parent reference
actions: If 'None' or no parent: Skip remaining substeps

substeps.name: Read parent process memory
substeps.description: Locate and read parent's memory file
actions: Get parent process path from memory.json

substeps.name: Find this sub-process in parent's table
substeps.description: Locate this sub-process entry in parent's Child Sub-Processes table
actions: Find 'Child Sub-Processes' table in parent memory.json

substeps.name: Update status to completed or failed
substeps.description: Update the status column for this sub-process
actions: Change status from 'running' to 'completed' (or 'failed' if applicable)

substeps.name: Add completion summary
substeps.description: Add summary of what was accomplished
actions: If summary provided, add to Notes or summary field

substeps.name: Write updated parent memory
substeps.description: Save the updated parent memory file
actions: Parent will detect completion at sync points via process-continue

flow.description: Check if sub-process → Read parent memory → Find self in table → Update status → Add summary → Write parent memory

memoryFileUsage.readFrom: Own memory.json (parent reference), Parent memory.json (child entry)

notes.pushModel: This step implements push notification - child updates parent, no polling needed
notes.skipCondition: Skip if process has no parent (is a root process)
